name: HA/DR Request and Tasking Flow
description: The chain from a host-nation disaster relief request to a tasked airlift sortie.

steps.description: Host-nation government / U.S. Embassy requests assistance following a disaster.
USAID's Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance (BHA) validates the need for a unique DoD capability.
Request enters the Mission Tasking Matrix (MiTaM) process to the Secretary of Defense.
INDOPACOM stands up a Joint Task Force to coordinate the response.

PACAF theater AOC's Air Mobility Division (AMD) tasks the airlift sortie, with DIRMOBFOR coordinating the mobility flow. AMD plans/coordinates/tasks air mobility missions in a process run parallel to and integrated with the main ATO cycle.
618 AOC/TACC tasks the specific tail number and crew.

doctrineSource.note: Added 2026-09-05 to ground step 5's AMD attribution.

name: Air Tasking Order (ATO) Cycle
description: The AOC's daily cycle for producing the ATO and its supporting documents.

steps.description: Combat Plans Division (CPD) builds the ATO (within 48 hours prior to execution).
SPINS, Airspace Control Order (ACO), and Airspace Control Plan (ACP) are published alongside the ATO by CPD.
Combat Operations Division (COD) executes the approved ATO/ACO during its 24-hour execution period.

doctrineSource.note: Corrected 2026-09-05 from a generic AFDP 3-0.1 citation to this primary source, which separates ATO production (CPD) from ATO execution (COD) — the original version of this process conflated the two into a single COD step.
